shellCommands.command: cat package.json; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/*.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>&1 | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rl "connection()" . | head; echo; grep -rn "no-store" 01-app/01-getting-started/*.md | head -20; ls 01-app/01-getting-started
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md; sed -n 1,200p 01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md | grep -n -i -A5 "request\|cache\|stream" | head -120

python3 - <<'EOF' p='app/page.tsx'; s=open(p).read() s=s.replace("import UserDashboard from './UserDashboard'","import { Suspense } from 'react'\nimport UserDashboard from './UserDashboard'") s=s.replace(" "," Loading user dashboard...

}>\n \n ") open(p,'w').write(s) EOF cat app/page.tsx; npx tsc --noEmit; echo tsc=$?; timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
